title: Social Links
description: I wanted to create a simple website that brought all my social links together, essentially working like a personal Linktree that I could share on my social profiles and make it easy for people to find me online.

title: Gerador de CPF
description: Generates mathematically valid Brazilian CPF numbers (correct check digits) for software testing, with a fiscal-region selector.

title: IG Relationship Checker
description: A web-based tool that analyzes your IG followers and following data. Upload your IG data export to identify mutual friends, inactive accounts, and who doesn't follow you back.
